paper_id: Large Language Model-Aware In-Context Learning for Code Generation
title: Large Language Model-Aware In-Context Learning for Code Generation
motivation: ICL性能对示例选择高度敏感,现有基于文本相似度的方法未考虑LLM自身的prior knowledge和preferences
problem_framing: 将example selection问题定义为学习LLM偏好的retrieval任务,通过LLM自身反馈生成labeled data训练neural retriever
key_insight: 用ground-truth programs的生成概率来衡量候选示例对LLM的有用程度,概率高者为positive,低者为negative
method_signature: 两阶段:BM25初筛→LLM概率估计→contrastive learning训练GraphCodeBERT retriever
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: larger size of S_i results in better performance but is more computationally expensive, leaving other sizes to future work
evidence_for_taste: performance usually varying from almost random to near state-of-the-art
selecting applicable examples for ICL becomes more urgent
they do not consider the prior knowledge in LLMs and ignore their preferences
Examples in ICL are supposed to provide information that LLMs require
thinking_moves: 从ICL不稳定性反推出示例选择的重要性
将启发式文本匹配方法的失效归因于忽略LLM自身偏好
把估计candidate example问题reframe为用LLM自身概率反馈label数据
通过contrastive learning使retriever与LLM偏好对齐而非与文本相似度对齐
